109: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
110: 
111: 		java.util.List<JCVariableDecl> fields = new ArrayList<JCVariableDecl>();
112: 		for (JavacNode child : typeNode.down()) {
113: 			if (child.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
114: 				JCVariableDecl v = (JCVariableDecl) child.get();
115: 				if ((v.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
116: 					fields.add(v);
117: 				}
118: 			}
119: 		}
120: 
121: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
122: 
123: 		rememberRecordType(typeNode);
124: 		for (int i = 0; i < fields.size(); i++) {
125: 			JCVariableDecl arg = fields.get(i);
126: 			appendRecordConstructorParameter(params, maker, arg);
127: 		}
128: 
129: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(AccessLevel.PUBLIC) | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
130: 		JCBlock body = maker.Block(0L, List.<JCStatement>nil());
131: 		if (existingCtr == null) {
132: 			JCMethodDecl constr = maker.MethodDef(mods, typeNode.toName("<init>"), null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(), body, null);
133: 			return recursiveSetGeneratedBy(constr, source);
134: 		} else {
135: 			existingCtr.mods = mods;
136: 			existingCtr.body = body;
137: 			existingCtr = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(existingCtr, source);

219: 			List<JCStatement> stats = statements;
220: 			int idx = 0;
221: 			while (stats.size() > idx) {
222: 				JCStatement stat = stats.get(idx++);
223: 				if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat)) continue;
224: 				if (stat instanceof JCTry) {

226: 					idx = 0;

228: 				}
229: 				if (stat instanceof JCSynchronized) {
230: 					stats = ((JCSynchronized) stat).body.stats;

236: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck.equals(expectedName)) return;

240: 		List<JCStatement> tail = statements;
241: 		List<JCStatement> head = List.nil();
242: 		for (JCStatement stat : statements) {
243: 			if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat) || (JavacHandlerUtil.isGenerated(stat) && isNullCheck(stat))) {
244: 				tail = tail.tail;
245: 				head = head.prepend(stat);
246: 				continue;
247: 			}
248: 			break;
249: 		}
250: 
251: 		List<JCStatement> newList = tail.prepend(nullCheck);
252: 		for (JCStatement stat : head) newList = newList.prepend(stat);
253: 		method.body.stats = newList;

257: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<NonNull> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
258: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE, "@NonNull");
259: 		if (annotationNode.up().getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
260: 			// This is meaningless unless the field is used to generate a method (@Setter, @RequiredArgsConstructor, etc),
261: 			// but in that case those handlers will take care of it. However, we DO check if the annotation is applied to
262: 			// a primitive, because those handlers trigger on any annotation named @NonNull and we only want the warning
263: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.
264: 			
265: 			try {
266: 				if (isPrimitive(((JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get()).vartype)) {
267: 					annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
268: 				}
269: 			} catch (Exception ignore) {}
270: 			
271: 			JCVariableDecl fDecl = (JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get();
272: 			if ((fDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
273: 				// well, these kinda double as parameters (of the compact constructor), so we do some work here.
274: 				
275: 				List<JCMethodDecl> compactConstructors = addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(annotationNode.up().up(), annotationNode);

278: 				}
279: 			}
280: 			return;
281: 		}

283: 		JCMethodDecl declaration;
284: 		JavacNode paramNode;
285: 		
286: 		switch (annotationNode.up().getKind()) {
287: 		case ARGUMENT:
288: 			paramNode = annotationNode.up();
289: 			break;
290: 		case TYPE_USE:
291: 			JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.directUp();
292: 			paramNode = typeNode.directUp();
293: 			break;
294: 		default:
295: 			return;
296: 		}
297: 		
298: 		if (paramNode.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) return;
299: 		try {
300: 			declaration = (JCMethodDecl) paramNode.up().get();
301: 		} catch (Exception e) {
302: 			return;
303: 		}
304: 		
305: 		if (declaration.body == null) {
306: 			// This used to be a warning, but as @NonNull also has a documentary purpose, better to not warn about this. Since 1.16.7
307: 			return;
308: 		}
309: 		
310: 		if ((declaration.mods.flags & (GENERATED_MEMBER | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR)) != 0) {
311: 			// The 'real' annotations are on the `record Foo(@NonNull Obj x)` part and we just see these
312: 			// syntax-sugared over. We deal with it on the field declaration variant, as those are always there,
313: 			// not dependent on whether you write out the compact constructor or not.
314: 			return;

320: 	public boolean isNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
321: 		return returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat) != null;

324: 	/**
325: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
326: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
327: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
328: 	 */
329: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
330: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
331: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
332: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
333: 
334: 		if (isExpression) {
335: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
336: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
337: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
338: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
339: 
340: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
341: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
342: 			Name name = null;
343: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
344: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
345: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
346: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
347: 			}
348: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals("checkNotNull") && !name.contentEquals("requireNonNull"))) return null;
349: 
350: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
351: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
352: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
353: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
354: 		}
355: 
356: 		if (isIf) {
357: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
358: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
359: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
360: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
361: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
362: 				then = stats.get(0);
363: 			}
364: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
365: 		}
366: 
367: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
368: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
369: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
370: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
371: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
372: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
373: 			if (isIf) {
374: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
375: 			} else {
376: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
377: 			}
378: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
379: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
380: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
381: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
382: 		}
